Paladin.name: Bio-Nanite Injector
Paladin.description: Points equal to 5 x your Vow-Bound Operative level. Regain all points on a long rest.

Sorcerer.name: Innate Sorcery
Sorcerer.description: As a bonus action unleash innate magic for 1 minute: your Sorcerer spell save DC increases by 1 and you have advantage on Sorcerer spell attack rolls. At class level 7, you may activate it with 2 mutation points when no uses remain.

Sorcerer.name: Mutation Points
Sorcerer.description: You gain 2 mutation points at 2nd level and one more at each Awakened Mutant level thereafter. Regain all points on a long rest. Spend points to create spell slots or expend slots to regain points (see Font of Mutation).
